notes: CBER letter for umbilical-cord-derived BioECM placental connective tissue matrix products (with named variants BioECM ActiveMatrix/BurnMatrix/CryoMatrix/MX/NX/RX/WoundEx): fails HCT/P minimal-manipulation and homologous-use criteria, making it an unapproved new drug/unlicensed biological product, plus CGMP violations (21 CFR 210/211) for aseptic-area environmental monitoring, endotoxin testing, batch records, and stability. Explicitly adulterated (501(a)(2)(B)). Additional related products (BioRenew, HRT BioPower-A, HRT BioPower-C, HRT NX) are named as an open question in the letter, so included in products. No organisms, no confirmed contamination, and no recall are mentioned.
